  "status": "NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT",
  "SYSTEM_INTERPRETATION_OF_USER_INTENT": "The system appears to interpret past interactions as continuing demand for broadly related items, with insufficient distinction between general interest and a useful next choice.",
  "WHERE_THE_SYSTEM_GETS_IT_RIGHT": [
    "Recommendations align when they extend a specific recurring interest, such as circuit building, photography storage, or a recognizable musical style.",
    "Practical complements to recently acquired equipment or supplies give users concrete reasons to choose an item."
  ],
  "WHERE_THE_SYSTEM_GETS_IT_WRONG": [
    "Broadly related products compete with more useful complements despite requiring unestablished equipment ownership, compatibility, or projects.",
    "Repeated purchases and older interests appear to imply continued demand even when recommendations duplicate recently satisfied needs or miss the current listening mood.",
    "For unidentified or ambiguous items, feedback cannot establish a preference match; these responses provide insufficient evidence to diagnose content relevance."
  ],
  "OVERUSED_DECISION_PATTERNS": [
    "Broad product-domain, device-ecosystem, artist-era, and musical-genre similarity appears to substitute for specific purpose or experience matching.",
    "Surface similarities such as assortment packaging, compilation titles, and seasonal themes appear to receive more weight than their relevance to the next choice."
  ],
  "UNDERUSED_OR_MISSED_DECISION_PATTERNS": [
    "Recent sequences can indicate a concrete task whose next useful step differs from another purchase in the same broad domain.",
    "Compatibility, dimensions, quantities, existing supplies, and functional overlap determine whether a related product is actually useful.",
    "Current mood, musical intensity, seasonality, and studio versus live format distinguish immediate choices from general interests."
  ],
  "PRIMARY_FAILURE_MODE_AT_TOP_OF_LIST": "Top-ranked items too often reflect broad historical affinity without a specific, supported reason for choosing them now.",
  "DIAGNOSTIC_SIGNALS_TO_TRACK": [
    "The proportion of top-ranked recommendations users would choose now, separated from items they consider merely related or potentially useful later.",
    "The frequency of rejection due to duplicated functionality, excessive quantity, unsupported compatibility, or an unestablished project.",
    "The frequency of current-task or mood matches among accepted recommendations compared with broad-domain matches among rejected recommendations.",
    "The proportion of recommendations whose relevance cannot be assessed because item identity is insufficiently established, tracked separately from explicit preference rejection."
  ]
}
